blind_spots_patched: Baseline ch-2 cited the >10% single-customer test but omitted MDLZ reliance on accounts receivable factoring and supply-chain finance programs alongside $10.14B FY25 / $9.51B Q326 accounts payable.
Baseline ch-3 omitted the 9M 2026 $1,091M non-cash unrealized derivative MTM gain, $245M net cash derivative settlement outflow, and $1,212M trade receivables working-capital drag.
Baseline ch-4 covered EUDR and hyperinflationary accounting but omitted explicit USMCA tariff exclusion in FY2026 guidance.
Baseline ch-5 omitted 2026 DEF 14A PSU metric design (no ROIC or net-leverage hurdle, 50% Adjusted EPS Growth) and November 2026 Form 4 insider sales by CEO Dirk Van de Put.

Baseline ch-6 stopped at FY2025 debt ($19.08B net debt) and missed Q3 2026 commercial paper surge (+38.1% to .61B), 0.12B net debt, 5.0B equity covenant, 4M Q3 brand impairments, and 15M 9M26 Europe restructuring.
assumptions_changed: CONFIRMED: Cocoa surplus in 2025/2026 drove spot cocoa down ~70% from peak and enabled Q3 2026 Adjusted Gross Margin rebound (+380 bps YoY to 34.2%).
CONFIRMED: No single retail customer accounted for more than 10% of consolidated FY2025 net revenues.
CONFIRMED: Q3 2026 marked an operational volume/mix inflection (+1.8 pp) and ~65% of revenue holding or gaining share, while North America and Clif Bar remain watchpoints.
WEAKENED: Balance sheet leverage crept higher as shareholder returns exceeded FCF through FY2025 ($19.08B net debt).
